verse.verse_3: Nay! You shall come to know!
verse.verse_4: Again nay! You shall come to know!
verse.verse_5: Nay! If you knew with a sure knowledge.
verse.verse_6: Verily, you shall see the blazing Fire!
verse.verse_7: And again, you shall see it with certainty of sight!
verse.verse_8: Then on that Day you shall be asked about the delights!
